title: GIMP - Development Update, August 2026
content_html:
For the past few months, we’ve been developing all kinds of features for the future GIMP 3.4 release. We noticed recently that our changelog was getting quite long - a good problem to have!

While there’s been a lot going on internally, it’s been a while since we made a public progress report. So we want to share details on some of the new features and UX improvements that’ll be available in the first development release, GIMP 3.3.2. This won’t be an exhaustive list (we have to save at least some news for the release itself!) but hopefully it will give you some insight into the current direction and progress of GIMP’s development.

  • New Project File Format
  • MyPaint Brush: Spectral Blending
  • Non-Destructive Editing
  • PSD Support Improvements
  • Native File Chooser Dialogs
  • User Experience and Interface Updates
  • Assorted Changes and Fixes
  • What’s Next

New Project File Format¶

The big focus for maintainer Jehan recently has been developing a new project file format for GIMP.

XCF has been GIMP’s primary project format since 1997, and it has served many users well. Over time however, we’ve observed more and more limitations of the binary XCF format. Among other issues, it does not easily support very large or complex projects, such as the multi-page and animation features currently planned for GIMP 3.6.

The new project file format will follow a more common “zipped XML” structure. While the technical details are still being designed and implemented, this change will allow for faster saving since we’ll only need to update parts of the file instead of the whole thing each time. It will also set the stage for much desired features such as auto-saving, which will now be much more feasible.

That said, XCF is not going away! Backwards compatibility is important to us, and we will continue to support loading XCFs in all future versions of GIMP. (For instance, we’re quite proud that a XCF file made by a small company for their logo in 1998 still renders the same way in the latest version of GIMP)

However, going forward we will only add support for saving/loading new features in the new project file format once it is finalized.

MyPaint Brush: Spectral Blending¶

During GIMP 3.2’s development, we upgraded to a newer version of the MyPaint brush engine. While this brought new brushes and canvas interactions to the MyPaint Brush Tool, one feature that was left out was Spectral Blending.

Spectral Blending simulates the effects of blending physical pigments in digital art. For example, blending yellow and blue will produce a green color instead of darker yellow, and blending red and yellow will create an orange mix.

Fortunately, new contributor Cassidie Grogan picked up the slack and implemented this feature. There is now a Spectral Blending checkbox in the MyPaint Brush Tool Options. If checked, the new blending method is used. You can control the strength of the blending with the Pigment slider.

Demonstration of MyPaint Spectral Blending

In addition, maintainer Michael Natterer improved the MyPaint Brush preview code to display at their full size instead of 48x48 pixels. This fixes an issue where the previews appeared blurry on larger screens.

Non-Destructive Editing¶

Alx Sa has continued making updates to our non-destructive filter code. To list a few:

You can now apply filters non-destructively to Layer masks! To go along with this, the filter popover has been redesigned by Reju to show the active filters for both the layer and its mask, so you can interact with both on the same screen.

The Gradient Tool can now be used non-destructively! If you check Editable Gradient in the Tool Options, the gradient you create will be added to the filter stack like any other effect. You can toggle its visibility, rearrange its position in the filter stack and delete it. You can also edit the gradient, which will switch back to the Gradient Tool to let you make further changes.

Filters without dialogs (such as Invert) can now be applied non-destructively on non-raster layers such as layer groups and link, text, and vector layers.

PSD Support Improvements¶

Normally we list all file format updates in a combined section, but there has been so much work done on PSD support (and by so many people) that we wanted to highlight it in more detail.

First, new contributor Frank Teklote has been busy improving our compatibility with PSDs. His big project for this release was creating a PSD metadata export procedure for TIFFs and JPEGs. This complements our existing PSD metadata import procedure, meaning that if you import a JPEG with paths or a TIFF with layers (or create one in GIMP), that information can now be retained in the exported image.

Another great thing about Frank’s work is that as we continue to improve our PSD compatibility, the TIFF and JPEG export features will automatically get those updates too!

Related to that, Jacob Boerema has implemented PSD Descriptor import support. Most of our current PSD support has been based on the public Adobe specification. This document was last updated in 2019 however, and modern PSDs use a relatively undocumented text format called Descriptors to store many features.

Now that GIMP can read descriptors, we’ve begun drastically improving our PSD import support. To list just a few updates: text layers are now editable, a number of adjustment layers and modern layer styles appear as their GEGL equivalents, and solid color shapes are imported as vector layers. This is an active area of development, including by two of our GSoC students Akascape and Waris Maqbool. We hope this work will make it easier for GIMP users to interact with existing PSD projects!

Native File Chooser Dialogs¶

We have always used the file chooser dialog provided by the GTK GUI library for people to find, load, and save files in GIMP. While the file chooser does the job, it often works differently than the “native” file chooser on non-GNOME platforms like Windows, macOS, and KDE. Additionally there have been some changes to the UI of this dialog in GTK3, which has inspired some strong feedback in our issue tracker!

Therefore, Alx Sa has begun porting GIMP’s file choosers to the “native” option provided in GTK3. This means that when you open or save a file, you will see your platform’s standard file chooser dialog instead of the GTK dialog (unless your platform uses that already, in which case there will be no change!)

Many of the simple dialogs have already been converted. Those with more complex additional features will require some workflow redesigns, which we’re still developing.

User Experience and Interface Updates¶

A lot of new and existing contributors have submitted improvements to GIMP’s user interface and its user experience. We wanted to highlight their efforts, and encourage you all to continue sharing your feedback on our design issue tracker.

Designer Denis Rangelov has been hard at work updating GIMP’s UI icons. He recreated our layer lock icons to create a more consistent look.

He also took on the monumental task of converting all 78 of our cursor icons to SVG, which will allow us to scale them for higher resolution displays without losing quality!

Original Raster Cursor Denis’s Vector Cursor
Example of original and vector cursors

There have been reported performance issues when drawing or zooming into the canvas when the canvas view was rotated. New contributor woot000 diagnosed the problem and created a fix. Now the “checkerboard” transparency pattern no longer rotates when the canvas does, which significantly boosts performance when painting or editing. They also fixed a related issue where the checkerboard pattern would disappear when zooming into the canvas past a certain point.

Gabriele Barbero implemented a redesign of the Search Action UI which was designed by Denis Rangelov. The new layout makes the associated shortcut key more visible, and is more consistent with the menu layouts.

Bruno Lopes has been working to fix issues with pop-up dialog displays on macOS. Since traditionally we have fewer macOS developers compared to other platforms, we’re really happy to see improvements for these users!

New contributor Andreas Vukman improved our Pattern dock display. Now smaller patterns tile to fill the available space, creating a consistent preview for all patterns instead of having some patterns display with odd amounts of padding. We think it makes the dock look much nicer!

Richard Gitschlag has updated the on-canvas text editor to allow selections when you Shift+Click in the text. It should now work similar to what you can do in a word processor like LibreOffice.

In previous versions of GIMP, you imported or exported metadata from the Metadata Editor by selecting an option in a dropdown. Ahmed E. Yassin has made this process more intuitive (and more consistent with the rest of GIMP’s UI) by replacing the dropdown with two buttons instead.

Ondřej Míchal reviewed several portions of GIMP’s UI and replaced many instances of the Spin Entry widget with Spin Scale. The Spin Entry widget is difficult to use when the width is shrunk, so this change improves usability in many areas of the UI.

Assorted Changes and Fixes¶

Our four GSoC interns have been continuing their work since the midpoint update. Recently, Waris Maqbool‘s Sharpen filter was merged into GEGL, so it’ll be available in the next GEGL release.

New contributor Dimitriy Ryazantcev has submitted several patches for improving our Windows ICO/CUR/ANI support. They’ve already fixed the rendering for certain 32bit ICO formats and made our loading and preview algorithms better match the Windows specification.

Estecka has fixed a rendering issue when applying NDE filters on passthrough layer groups, which made the image look different depending on whether the group had child layers or not.

New contributor Petr Vorel fixed a bug where pressing Alt+0 did not open the tenth most recent image in your history.

Lloyd Konneker, our main Script-fu contributor, fixed a regression in third party scripts where the number range for certain parameters wasn’t shown in the GUI.

Jacob Boerema and Alx Sa have responded to and patched a number of security reports about potential flaws in some of our image plug-ins.

What’s Next¶

There’s more in-progress work that we look forward to sharing with you all soon!

There is not an official 3.3.2 development release yet, as several roadmap items are still in-progress. If you’re feeling really adventurous and just can’t wait, you can try our “nightly” builds. Instructions are under the Automatic Development Builds header.

In the meantime, we are planning to release GIMP 3.2.6 in the coming weeks. It is a stable release so it won’t include many of the new features described here. However, it will have a number of important bug fixes and small improvements. We’ll discuss these more in the 3.2.6 release news post!

sentences.zh: 您可以使用颜料滑块控制混合的强度。

blocks.html_en: In addition, maintainer Michael Natterer improved the MyPaint Brush preview code to display at their full size instead of 48x48 pixels. This fixes an issue where the previews appeared blurry on larger screens.

sentences.en: In addition, maintainer Michael Natterer improved the MyPaint Brush preview code to display at their full size instead of 48x48 pixels.
sentences.zh: 此外，维护者 Michael Natterer 改进了 MyPaint Brush 预览代码，使其以全尺寸显示，而不是 48x48 像素。

sentences.en: This fixes an issue where the previews appeared blurry on larger screens.
sentences.zh: 这解决了预览在较大屏幕上显得模糊的问题。

blocks.html_en: Non-Destructive Editing¶

sentences.en: Non-Destructive Editing¶
sentences.zh: 非破坏性编辑¶

blocks.html_en: Alx Sa has continued making updates to our non-destructive filter code. To list a few:

sentences.en: Alx Sa has continued making updates to our non-destructive filter code.
sentences.zh: Alx Sa 继续更新我们的非破坏性过滤器代码。

sentences.en: To list a few:
sentences.zh: 列出一些：

blocks.html_en: You can now apply filters non-destructively to Layer masks! To go along with this, the filter popover has been redesigned by Reju to show the active filters for both the layer and its mask, so you can interact with both on the same screen.

sentences.en: You can now apply filters non-destructively to Layer masks!
sentences.zh: 您现在可以将滤镜无损地应用于图层蒙版！

sentences.en: To go along with this, the filter popover has been redesigned by Reju to show the active filters for both the layer and its mask, so you can interact with both on the same screen.
sentences.zh: 为此，Reju 重新设计了滤镜弹出窗口，以显示图层及其蒙版的活动滤镜，以便您可以在同一屏幕上与两者进行交互。

blocks.html_en: The Gradient Tool can now be used non-destructively! If you check Editable Gradient in the Tool Options, the gradient you create will be added to the filter stack like any other effect. You can toggle its visibility, rearrange its position in the filter stack and delete it. You can also edit the gradient, which will switch back to the Gradient Tool to let you make further changes.

sentences.en: The Gradient Tool can now be used non-destructively!
sentences.zh: 渐变工具现在可以非破坏性地使用！

sentences.en: If you check Editable Gradient in the Tool Options, the gradient you create will be added to the filter stack like any other effect.
sentences.zh: 如果您在“工具选项”中选中“可编辑渐变”，您创建的渐变将像任何其他效果一样添加到滤镜堆栈中。

sentences.en: You can toggle its visibility, rearrange its position in the filter stack and delete it.
sentences.zh: 您可以切换其可见性、重新排列其在过滤器堆栈中的位置以及将其删除。

sentences.en: You can also edit the gradient, which will switch back to the Gradient Tool to let you make further changes.
sentences.zh: 您还可以编辑渐变，这将切换回渐变工具，以便您进行进一步的更改。

sentences.en: User interface with a live Gradient filter on the layer, and a live filter on the layer mask
sentences.zh: 用户界面，图层上有实时渐变滤镜，图层蒙版上有实时滤镜

blocks.html_en: Filters without dialogs (such as Invert) can now be applied non-destructively on non-raster layers such as layer groups and link, text, and vector layers.

sentences.en: Filters without dialogs (such as Invert) can now be applied non-destructively on non-raster layers such as layer groups and link, text, and vector layers.
sentences.zh: 不带对话框的过滤器（例如反转）现在可以非破坏性地应用于非栅格图层，例如图层组以及链接层、文本层和矢量图层。

blocks.html_en: PSD Support Improvements¶

sentences.en: PSD Support Improvements¶
sentences.zh: PSD 支持改进¶

blocks.html_en: Normally we list all file format updates in a combined section, but there has been so much work done on PSD support (and by so many people) that we wanted to highlight it in more detail.

sentences.en: Normally we list all file format updates in a combined section, but there has been so much work done on PSD support (and by so many people) that we wanted to highlight it in more detail.
sentences.zh: 通常，我们会在组合部分中列出所有文件格式更新，但在 PSD 支持（以及很多人）方面已经做了很多工作，因此我们希望更详细地强调它。

blocks.html_en: First, new contributor Frank Teklote has been busy improving our compatibility with PSDs. His big project for this release was creating a PSD metadata export procedure for TIFFs and JPEGs. This complements our existing PSD metadata import procedure, meaning that if you import a JPEG with paths or a TIFF with layers (or create one in GIMP), that information can now be retained in the exported image.

sentences.en: First, new contributor Frank Teklote has been busy improving our compatibility with PSDs.
sentences.zh: 首先，新贡献者 Frank Teklote 一直忙于改进我们与 PSD 的兼容性。

sentences.en: His big project for this release was creating a PSD metadata export procedure for TIFFs and JPEGs.
sentences.zh: 他在此版本中的大项目是为 TIFF 和 JPEG 创建 PSD 元数据导出程序。

sentences.en: This complements our existing PSD metadata import procedure, meaning that if you import a JPEG with paths or a TIFF with layers (or create one in GIMP), that information can now be retained in the exported image.
sentences.zh: 这补充了我们现有的 PSD 元数据导入过程，这意味着如果您导入带有路径的 JPEG 或带有图层的 TIFF（或在 GIMP 中创建一个），该信息现在可以保留在导出的图像中。

blocks.html_en: Another great thing about Frank’s work is that as we continue to improve our PSD compatibility, the TIFF and JPEG export features will automatically get those updates too!

sentences.en: Another great thing about Frank’s work is that as we continue to improve our PSD compatibility, the TIFF and JPEG export features will automatically get those updates too!
sentences.zh: Frank 工作的另一件伟大的事情是，随着我们不断提高 PSD 兼容性，TIFF 和 JPEG 导出功能也将自动获得这些更新！

blocks.html_en: Related to that, Jacob Boerema has implemented PSD Descriptor import support. Most of our current PSD support has been based on the public Adobe specification. This document was last updated in 2019 however, and modern PSDs use a relatively undocumented text format called Descriptors to store many features.

sentences.en: Related to that, Jacob Boerema has implemented PSD Descriptor import support.
sentences.zh: 与此相关的是，Jacob Boerema 实现了 PSD 描述符导入支持。

sentences.en: Most of our current PSD support has been based on the public Adobe specification.
sentences.zh: 我们当前的大部分 PSD 支持都基于公共 Adob​​e 规范。

sentences.en: This document was last updated in 2019 however, and modern PSDs use a relatively undocumented text format called Descriptors to store many features.
sentences.zh: 然而，该文档最后一次更新是在 2019 年，现代 PSD 使用一种相对未记录的文本格式（称为描述符）来存储许多功能。

blocks.html_en: Now that GIMP can read descriptors, we’ve begun drastically improving our PSD import support. To list just a few updates: text layers are now editable, a number of adjustment layers and modern layer styles appear as their GEGL equivalents, and solid color shapes are imported as vector layers. This is an active area of development, including by two of our GSoC students Akascape and Waris Maqbool. We hope this work will make it easier for GIMP users to interact with existing PSD projects!

sentences.en: Now that GIMP can read descriptors, we’ve begun drastically improving our PSD import support.
sentences.zh: 现在 GIMP 可以读取描述符，我们已经开始大幅改进 PSD 导入支持。

sentences.en: To list just a few updates: text layers are now editable, a number of adjustment layers and modern layer styles appear as their GEGL equivalents, and solid color shapes are imported as vector layers.
sentences.zh: 仅列出一些更新：文本图层现在可编辑，许多调整图层和现代图层样式显示为其 GEGL 等效项，纯色形状作为矢量图层导入。

sentences.en: This is an active area of development, including by two of our GSoC students Akascape and Waris Maqbool.
sentences.zh: 这是一个活跃的开发领域，包括我们的两名 GSoC 学生 Akascape 和 Waris Maqbool。

sentences.en: We hope this work will make it easier for GIMP users to interact with existing PSD projects!
sentences.zh: 我们希望这项工作能让 GIMP 用户更轻松地与现有的 PSD 项目进行交互！

sentences.en: Editable PSD text layers in GIMP
sentences.zh: GIMP 中可编辑的 PSD 文本图层

blocks.html_en: Native File Chooser Dialogs¶

sentences.en: Native File Chooser Dialogs¶
sentences.zh: 本机文件选择器对话框¶

blocks.html_en: We have always used the file chooser dialog provided by the GTK GUI library for people to find, load, and save files in GIMP. While the file chooser does the job, it often works differently than the “native” file chooser on non-GNOME platforms like Windows, macOS, and KDE. Additionally there have been some changes to the UI of this dialog in GTK3, which has inspired some strong feedback in our issue tracker!

sentences.en: We have always used the file chooser dialog provided by the GTK GUI library for people to find, load, and save files in GIMP.
sentences.zh: 我们一直使用 GTK GUI 库提供的文件选择器对话框，供人们在 GIMP 中查找、加载和保存文件。

sentences.en: While the file chooser does the job, it often works differently than the “native” file chooser on non-GNOME platforms like Windows, macOS, and KDE.
sentences.zh: 虽然文件选择器可以完成这项工作，但它的工作方式通常与 Windows、macOS 和 KDE 等非 GNOME 平台上的“本机”文件选择器不同。

sentences.en: Additionally there have been some changes to the UI of this dialog in GTK3, which has inspired some strong feedback in our issue tracker!
sentences.zh: 此外，GTK3 中此对话框的 UI 也发生了一些变化，这在我们的问题跟踪器中激发了一些强烈的反馈！

blocks.html_en: Therefore, Alx Sa has begun porting GIMP’s file choosers to the “native” option provided in GTK3. This means that when you open or save a file, you will see your platform’s standard file chooser dialog instead of the GTK dialog (unless your platform uses that already, in which case there will be no change!)

sentences.en: Therefore, Alx Sa has begun porting GIMP’s file choosers to the “native” option provided in GTK3.
sentences.zh: 因此，Alx Sa 已开始将 GIMP 的文件选择器移植到 GTK3 中提供的“本机”选项。

sentences.en: This means that when you open or save a file, you will see your platform’s standard file chooser dialog instead of the GTK dialog (unless your platform uses that already, in which case there will be no change!)
sentences.zh: 这意味着当您打开或保存文件时，您将看到平台的标准文件选择器对话框，而不是 GTK 对话框（除非您的平台已经使用它，在这种情况下不会有任何变化！）

sentences.en: Example of native file chooser on macOS, by Bruno Lopes
sentences.zh: macOS 上的本机文件选择器示例，作者：Bruno Lopes

blocks.html_en: Many of the simple dialogs have already been converted. Those with more complex additional features will require some workflow redesigns, which we’re still developing.

sentences.en: Many of the simple dialogs have already been converted.
sentences.zh: 许多简单的对话框已经被转换。

sentences.en: Those with more complex additional features will require some workflow redesigns, which we’re still developing.
sentences.zh: 那些具有更复杂附加功能的功能将需要重新设计一些工作流程，我们仍在开发中。

blocks.html_en: User Experience and Interface Updates¶

sentences.en: User Experience and Interface Updates¶
sentences.zh: 用户体验和界面更新¶

blocks.html_en: A lot of new and existing contributors have submitted improvements to GIMP’s user interface and its user experience. We wanted to highlight their efforts, and encourage you all to continue sharing your feedback on our design issue tracker.

sentences.en: A lot of new and existing contributors have submitted improvements to GIMP’s user interface and its user experience.
sentences.zh: 许多新的和现有的贡献者已经提交了对 GIMP 用户界面及其用户体验的改进。

sentences.en: We wanted to highlight their efforts, and encourage you all to continue sharing your feedback on our design issue tracker.
sentences.zh: 我们希望强调他们的努力，并鼓励大家继续分享对我们的设计问题跟踪器的反馈。

blocks.html_en: Designer Denis Rangelov has been hard at work updating GIMP’s UI icons. He recreated our layer lock icons to create a more consistent look.

sentences.en: Designer Denis Rangelov has been hard at work updating GIMP’s UI icons.
sentences.zh: 设计师 Denis Rangelov 一直在努力更新 GIMP 的 UI 图标。

sentences.en: He recreated our layer lock icons to create a more consistent look.
sentences.zh: 他重新创建了我们的图层锁定图标以创建更一致的外观。

blocks.html_en: He also took on the monumental task of converting all 78 of our cursor icons to SVG, which will allow us to scale them for higher resolution displays without losing quality!

sentences.en: He also took on the monumental task of converting all 78 of our cursor icons to SVG, which will allow us to scale them for higher resolution displays without losing quality!
sentences.zh: 他还承担了将我们所有 78 个光标图标转换为 SVG 的艰巨任务，这将使我们能够在不损失质量的情况下缩放它们以实现更高分辨率的显示！

blocks.html_en: <th>Original Raster Cursor</th>

sentences.en: Original Raster Cursor
sentences.zh: 原始光栅光标

blocks.html_en: <th>Denis’s Vector Cursor</th>

sentences.en: Denis’s Vector Cursor
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯的矢量光标

blocks.html_en: There have been reported performance issues when drawing or zooming into the canvas when the canvas view was rotated. New contributor woot000 diagnosed the problem and created a fix. Now the “checkerboard” transparency pattern no longer rotates when the canvas does, which significantly boosts performance when painting or editing. They also fixed a related issue where the checkerboard pattern would disappear when zooming into the canvas past a certain point.

sentences.en: There have been reported performance issues when drawing or zooming into the canvas when the canvas view was rotated.
sentences.zh: 据报告，在画布视图旋转时绘制或放大画布时会出现性能问题。

sentences.en: New contributor woot000 diagnosed the problem and created a fix.
sentences.zh: 新贡献者 woot000 诊断了该问题并创建了修复程序。

sentences.en: Now the “checkerboard” transparency pattern no longer rotates when the canvas does, which significantly boosts performance when painting or editing.
sentences.zh: 现在，当画布旋转时，“棋盘”透明度图案不再旋转，这显着提高了绘画或编辑时的性能。

sentences.en: They also fixed a related issue where the checkerboard pattern would disappear when zooming into the canvas past a certain point.
sentences.zh: 他们还修复了一个相关问题，即当放大画布超过某个点时，棋盘图案会消失。

blocks.html_en: Gabriele Barbero implemented a redesign of the Search Action UI which was designed by Denis Rangelov. The new layout makes the associated shortcut key more visible, and is more consistent with the menu layouts.

sentences.en: Gabriele Barbero implemented a redesign of the Search Action UI which was designed by Denis Rangelov.
sentences.zh: Gabriele Barbero 对由 Denis Rangelov 设计的搜索操作 UI 进行了重新设计。

sentences.en: The new layout makes the associated shortcut key more visible, and is more consistent with the menu layouts.
sentences.zh: 新的布局使关联的快捷键更加明显，并且与菜单布局更加一致。

blocks.html_en: Bruno Lopes has been working to fix issues with pop-up dialog displays on macOS. Since traditionally we have fewer macOS developers compared to other platforms, we’re really happy to see improvements for these users!

sentences.en: Bruno Lopes has been working to fix issues with pop-up dialog displays on macOS.
sentences.zh: Bruno Lopes 一直致力于解决 macOS 上弹出对话框显示的问题。

sentences.en: Since traditionally we have fewer macOS developers compared to other platforms, we’re really happy to see improvements for these users!
sentences.zh: 由于传统上与其他平台相比，我们的 macOS 开发人员较少，因此我们非常高兴看到这些用户的改进！

blocks.html_en: New contributor Andreas Vukman improved our Pattern dock display. Now smaller patterns tile to fill the available space, creating a consistent preview for all patterns instead of having some patterns display with odd amounts of padding. We think it makes the dock look much nicer!

sentences.en: New contributor Andreas Vukman improved our Pattern dock display.
sentences.zh: 新贡献者 Andreas Vukman 改进了我们的图案停靠显示。

sentences.en: Now smaller patterns tile to fill the available space, creating a consistent preview for all patterns instead of having some patterns display with odd amounts of padding.
sentences.zh: 现在，较小的图案平铺以填充可用空间，为所有图案创建一致的预览，而不是让某些图案显示带有奇数填充量。

sentences.en: We think it makes the dock look much nicer!
sentences.zh: 我们认为它让码头看起来更漂亮！

blocks.html_en: Richard Gitschlag has updated the on-canvas text editor to allow selections when you Shift+Click in the text. It should now work similar to what you can do in a word processor like LibreOffice.

sentences.en: Richard Gitschlag has updated the on-canvas text editor to allow selections when you Shift+Click in the text.
sentences.zh: Richard Gitschlag 更新了画布上的文本编辑器，允许您在文本中按住 Shift 键并单击时进行选择。

sentences.en: It should now work similar to what you can do in a word processor like LibreOffice.
sentences.zh: 现在，它的工作方式应该与您在 LibreOffice 等文字处理程序中执行的操作类似。

blocks.html_en: In previous versions of GIMP, you imported or exported metadata from the Metadata Editor by selecting an option in a dropdown. Ahmed E. Yassin has made this process more intuitive (and more consistent with the rest of GIMP’s UI) by replacing the dropdown with two buttons instead.

sentences.en: In previous versions of GIMP, you imported or exported metadata from the Metadata Editor by selecting an option in a dropdown.
sentences.zh: 在 GIMP 的早期版本中，您可以通过在下拉列表中选择一个选项来从元数据编辑器导入或导出元数据。

sentences.en: Ahmed E.
sentences.zh: 艾哈迈德·E.

sentences.en: Yassin has made this process more intuitive (and more consistent with the rest of GIMP’s UI) by replacing the dropdown with two buttons instead.
sentences.zh: Yassin 通过用两个按钮替换下拉菜单，使这个过程更加直观（并且与 GIMP UI 的其余部分更加一致）。

blocks.html_en: Ondřej Míchal reviewed several portions of GIMP’s UI and replaced many instances of the Spin Entry widget with Spin Scale. The Spin Entry widget is difficult to use when the width is shrunk, so this change improves usability in many areas of the UI.

sentences.en: Ondřej Míchal reviewed several portions of GIMP’s UI and replaced many instances of the Spin Entry widget with Spin Scale.
sentences.zh: Ondřej Míchal 审查了 GIMP UI 的多个部分，并用 Spin Scale 替换了 Spin Entry 小部件的许多实例。

sentences.en: The Spin Entry widget is difficult to use when the width is shrunk, so this change improves usability in many areas of the UI.
sentences.zh: 当宽度缩小时，Spin Entry 小部件很难使用，因此此更改提高了 UI 许多区域的可用性。

blocks.html_en: Assorted Changes and Fixes¶

sentences.en: Assorted Changes and Fixes¶
sentences.zh: 各种更改和修复¶

blocks.html_en: Our four GSoC interns have been continuing their work since the midpoint update. Recently, Waris Maqbool‘s Sharpen filter was merged into GEGL, so it’ll be available in the next GEGL release.

sentences.en: Our four GSoC interns have been continuing their work since the midpoint update.
sentences.zh: 自中点更新以来，我们的四名 GSoC 实习生一直在继续他们的工作。

sentences.en: Recently, Waris Maqbool‘s Sharpen filter was merged into GEGL, so it’ll be available in the next GEGL release.
sentences.zh: 最近，Waris Maqbool 的 Sharpen 滤镜已合并到 GEGL 中，因此它将在下一个 GEGL 版本中提供。

blocks.html_en: New contributor Dimitriy Ryazantcev has submitted several patches for improving our Windows ICO/CUR/ANI support. They’ve already fixed the rendering for certain 32bit ICO formats and made our loading and preview algorithms better match the Windows specification.

sentences.en: New contributor Dimitriy Ryazantcev has submitted several patches for improving our Windows ICO/CUR/ANI support.
sentences.zh: 新贡献者 Dimitriy Ryazantcev 提交了多个补丁来改进我们的 Windows ICO/CUR/ANI 支持。

sentences.en: They’ve already fixed the rendering for certain 32bit ICO formats and made our loading and preview algorithms better match the Windows specification.
sentences.zh: 他们已经修复了某些 32 位 ICO 格式的渲染问题，并使我们的加载和预览算法更好地符合 Windows 规范。

blocks.html_en: Estecka has fixed a rendering issue when applying NDE filters on passthrough layer groups, which made the image look different depending on whether the group had child layers or not.

sentences.en: Estecka has fixed a rendering issue when applying NDE filters on passthrough layer groups, which made the image look different depending on whether the group had child layers or not.
sentences.zh: Esteka 修复了在直通图层组上应用 NDE 滤镜时的渲染问题，这使得图像看起来有所不同，具体取决于该组是否具有子图层。

blocks.html_en: New contributor Petr Vorel fixed a bug where pressing Alt+0 did not open the tenth most recent image in your history.

sentences.en: New contributor Petr Vorel fixed a bug where pressing Alt+0 did not open the tenth most recent image in your history.
sentences.zh: 新贡献者 Petr Vorel 修复了按 Alt+0 无法打开历史记录中第十个最新图像的错误。

blocks.html_en: Lloyd Konneker, our main Script-fu contributor, fixed a regression in third party scripts where the number range for certain parameters wasn’t shown in the GUI.

sentences.en: Lloyd Konneker, our main Script-fu contributor, fixed a regression in third party scripts where the number range for certain parameters wasn’t shown in the GUI.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要 Script-fu 贡献者 Lloyd Konneker 修复了第三方脚本中的回归问题，其中某些参数的数字范围未在 GUI 中显示。

blocks.html_en: Jacob Boerema and Alx Sa have responded to and patched a number of security reports about potential flaws in some of our image plug-ins.

sentences.en: Jacob Boerema and Alx Sa have responded to and patched a number of security reports about potential flaws in some of our image plug-ins.
sentences.zh: Jacob Boerema 和 Alx Sa 已对一些有关我们某些图像插件中潜在缺陷的安全报告做出了回应并修补了这些报告。

blocks.html_en: What’s Next¶

sentences.en: What’s Next¶
sentences.zh: 下一步是什么¶

blocks.html_en: There’s more in-progress work that we look forward to sharing with you all soon!

sentences.en: There’s more in-progress work that we look forward to sharing with you all soon!
sentences.zh: 我们还有更多正在进行的工作，期待很快与大家分享！

blocks.html_en: There is not an official 3.3.2 development release yet, as several roadmap items are still in-progress. If you’re feeling really adventurous and just can’t wait, you can try our “nightly” builds. Instructions are under the Automatic Development Builds header.

sentences.en: There is not an official 3.3.2 development release yet, as several roadmap items are still in-progress.
sentences.zh: 目前还没有正式的 3.3.2 开发版本，因为几个路线图项目仍在进行中。

sentences.en: If you’re feeling really adventurous and just can’t wait, you can try our “nightly” builds.
sentences.zh: 如果您真的很喜欢冒险并且迫不及待，您可以尝试我们的“夜间”构建。

sentences.en: Instructions are under the Automatic Development Builds header.
sentences.zh: 说明位于“自动开发构建”标题下。

blocks.html_en: In the meantime, we are planning to release GIMP 3.2.6 in the coming weeks. It is a stable release so it won’t include many of the new features described here. However, it will have a number of important bug fixes and small improvements. We’ll discuss these more in the 3.2.6 release news post!

sentences.en: In the meantime, we are planning to release GIMP 3.2.6 in the coming weeks.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们计划在未来几周内发布 GIMP 3.2.6。

sentences.en: It is a stable release so it won’t include many of the new features described here.
sentences.zh: 它是一个稳定版本，因此不会包含此处描述的许多新功能。

sentences.en: However, it will have a number of important bug fixes and small improvements.
sentences.zh: 然而，它将有许多重要的错误修复和小改进。

content_html_zh:
在过去的几个月里，我们一直在为未来的 GIMP 3.4 版本开发各种功能。 我们最近注意到我们的变更日志变得相当长——这是一个好问题！

虽然内部发生了很多事情，但我们已经有一段时间没有发布公开进度报告了。 因此，我们希望分享第一个开发版本 GIMP 3.3.2 中提供的一些新功能和用户体验改进的详细信息。 这不会是一个详尽的列表（我们必须至少为发布本身保存一些新闻！） 但希望它能让您了解 GIMP 目前的发展方向和进展。

  • 新的项目文件格式
  • MyPaint Brush：光谱混合
  • 非破坏性编辑
  • PSD 支持改进
  • 本机文件选择器对话框
  • 用户体验和界面更新
  • 各种更改和修复
  • 下一步是什么

新的项目文件格式¶

维护者 Jehan 最近的重点是为 GIMP 开发一种新的项目文件格式。

自 1997 年以来，XCF 一直是 GIMP 的主要项目格式，并且为许多用户提供了良好的服务。 然而，随着时间的推移，我们观察到二进制 XCF 格式越来越多的限制。 除其他问题外，它不容易支持非常大或复杂的项目，例如 GIMP 3.6 目前计划的多页面和动画功能。

新的项目文件格式将遵循更常见的“压缩 XML”结构。 虽然技术细节仍在设计和实施中，但这一更改将允许更快地保存，因为我们每次只需要更新文件的一部分而不是整个文件。 它还将为许多理想的功能奠定基础，例如自动保存，现在这将变得更加可行。

也就是说，XCF 不会消失！ 向后兼容性对我们来说很重要，我们将继续支持在 GIMP 的所有未来版本中加载 XCF。 （例如，我们非常自豪的是，一家小公司在 1998 年为其徽标制作的 XCF 文件在最新版本的 GIMP 中仍然以相同的方式呈现）

但是，今后我们只会在新项目文件格式最终确定后添加对保存/加载新功能的支持。

MyPaint Brush：光谱混合¶

在 GIMP 3.2 的开发过程中，我们升级到了更新版本的 MyPaint 画笔引擎。 虽然这为 MyPaint 画笔工具带来了新的画笔和画布交互，但其中一项被遗漏的功能是光谱混合。

光谱混合模拟数字艺术中混合物理颜料的效果。 例如，混合黄色和蓝色将产生绿色而不是深黄色，混合红色和黄色将产生橙色混合物。

幸运的是，新贡献者 Cassidie Grogan 弥补了这一缺陷并实现了此功能。 MyPaint 画笔工具选项中现在有一个光谱混合复选框。 如果选中，则使用新的混合方法。 您可以使用颜料滑块控制混合的强度。

Demonstration of MyPaint Spectral Blending

此外，维护者 Michael Natterer 改进了 MyPaint Brush 预览代码，使其以全尺寸显示，而不是 48x48 像素。 这解决了预览在较大屏幕上显得模糊的问题。

非破坏性编辑¶

Alx Sa 继续更新我们的非破坏性过滤器代码。 列出一些：

您现在可以将滤镜无损地应用于图层蒙版！ 为此，Reju 重新设计了滤镜弹出窗口，以显示图层及其蒙版的活动滤镜，以便您可以在同一屏幕上与两者进行交互。

渐变工具现在可以非破坏性地使用！ 如果您在“工具选项”中选中“可编辑渐变”，您创建的渐变将像任何其他效果一样添加到滤镜堆栈中。 您可以切换其可见性、重新排列其在过滤器堆栈中的位置以及将其删除。 您还可以编辑渐变，这将切换回渐变工具，以便您进行进一步的更改。

不带对话框的过滤器（例如反转）现在可以非破坏性地应用于非栅格图层，例如图层组以及链接层、文本层和矢量图层。

PSD 支持改进¶

通常，我们会在组合部分中列出所有文件格式更新，但在 PSD 支持（以及很多人）方面已经做了很多工作，因此我们希望更详细地强调它。

首先，新贡献者 Frank Teklote 一直忙于改进我们与 PSD 的兼容性。 他在此版本中的大项目是为 TIFF 和 JPEG 创建 PSD 元数据导出程序。 这补充了我们现有的 PSD 元数据导入过程，这意味着如果您导入带有路径的 JPEG 或带有图层的 TIFF（或在 GIMP 中创建一个），该信息现在可以保留在导出的图像中。

Frank 工作的另一件伟大的事情是，随着我们不断提高 PSD 兼容性，TIFF 和 JPEG 导出功能也将自动获得这些更新！

与此相关的是，Jacob Boerema 实现了 PSD 描述符导入支持。 我们当前的大部分 PSD 支持都基于公共 Adob​​e 规范。 然而，该文档最后一次更新是在 2019 年，现代 PSD 使用一种相对未记录的文本格式（称为描述符）来存储许多功能。

现在 GIMP 可以读取描述符，我们已经开始大幅改进 PSD 导入支持。 仅列出一些更新：文本图层现在可编辑，许多调整图层和现代图层样式显示为其 GEGL 等效项，纯色形状作为矢量图层导入。 这是一个活跃的开发领域，包括我们的两名 GSoC 学生 Akascape 和 Waris Maqbool。 我们希望这项工作能让 GIMP 用户更轻松地与现有的 PSD 项目进行交互！

本机文件选择器对话框¶

我们一直使用 GTK GUI 库提供的文件选择器对话框，供人们在 GIMP 中查找、加载和保存文件。 虽然文件选择器可以完成这项工作，但它的工作方式通常与 Windows、macOS 和 KDE 等非 GNOME 平台上的“本机”文件选择器不同。 此外，GTK3 中此对话框的 UI 也发生了一些变化，这在我们的问题跟踪器中激发了一些强烈的反馈！

因此，Alx Sa 已开始将 GIMP 的文件选择器移植到 GTK3 中提供的“本机”选项。 这意味着当您打开或保存文件时，您将看到平台的标准文件选择器对话框，而不是 GTK 对话框（除非您的平台已经使用它，在这种情况下不会有任何变化！）

许多简单的对话框已经被转换。 那些具有更复杂附加功能的功能将需要重新设计一些工作流程，我们仍在开发中。

用户体验和界面更新¶

许多新的和现有的贡献者已经提交了对 GIMP 用户界面及其用户体验的改进。 我们希望强调他们的努力，并鼓励大家继续分享对我们的设计问题跟踪器的反馈。

设计师 Denis Rangelov 一直在努力更新 GIMP 的 UI 图标。 他重新创建了我们的图层锁定图标以创建更一致的外观。

他还承担了将我们所有 78 个光标图标转换为 SVG 的艰巨任务，这将使我们能够在不损失质量的情况下缩放它们以实现更高分辨率的显示！

原始光栅光标 丹尼斯的矢量光标
Example of original and vector cursors

据报告，在画布视图旋转时绘制或放大画布时会出现性能问题。 新贡献者 woot000 诊断了该问题并创建了修复程序。 现在，当画布旋转时，“棋盘”透明度图案不再旋转，这显着提高了绘画或编辑时的性能。 他们还修复了一个相关问题，即当放大画布超过某个点时，棋盘图案会消失。

Gabriele Barbero 对由 Denis Rangelov 设计的搜索操作 UI 进行了重新设计。 新的布局使关联的快捷键更加明显，并且与菜单布局更加一致。

Bruno Lopes 一直致力于解决 macOS 上弹出对话框显示的问题。 由于传统上与其他平台相比，我们的 macOS 开发人员较少，因此我们非常高兴看到这些用户的改进！

新贡献者 Andreas Vukman 改进了我们的图案停靠显示。 现在，较小的图案平铺以填充可用空间，为所有图案创建一致的预览，而不是让某些图案显示带有奇数填充量。 我们认为它让码头看起来更漂亮！

Richard Gitschlag 更新了画布上的文本编辑器，允许您在文本中按住 Shift 键并单击时进行选择。 现在，它的工作方式应该与您在 LibreOffice 等文字处理程序中执行的操作类似。

在 GIMP 的早期版本中，您可以通过在下拉列表中选择一个选项来从元数据编辑器导入或导出元数据。 艾哈迈德·E. Yassin 通过用两个按钮替换下拉菜单，使这个过程更加直观（并且与 GIMP UI 的其余部分更加一致）。

Ondřej Míchal 审查了 GIMP UI 的多个部分，并用 Spin Scale 替换了 Spin Entry 小部件的许多实例。 当宽度缩小时，Spin Entry 小部件很难使用，因此此更改提高了 UI 许多区域的可用性。

各种更改和修复¶

自中点更新以来，我们的四名 GSoC 实习生一直在继续他们的工作。 最近，Waris Maqbool 的 Sharpen 滤镜已合并到 GEGL 中，因此它将在下一个 GEGL 版本中提供。

新贡献者 Dimitriy Ryazantcev 提交了多个补丁来改进我们的 Windows ICO/CUR/ANI 支持。 他们已经修复了某些 32 位 ICO 格式的渲染问题，并使我们的加载和预览算法更好地符合 Windows 规范。

Esteka 修复了在直通图层组上应用 NDE 滤镜时的渲染问题，这使得图像看起来有所不同，具体取决于该组是否具有子图层。

新贡献者 Petr Vorel 修复了按 Alt+0 无法打开历史记录中第十个最新图像的错误。

我们的主要 Script-fu 贡献者 Lloyd Konneker 修复了第三方脚本中的回归问题，其中某些参数的数字范围未在 GUI 中显示。

Jacob Boerema 和 Alx Sa 已对一些有关我们某些图像插件中潜在缺陷的安全报告做出了回应并修补了这些报告。

下一步是什么¶

我们还有更多正在进行的工作，期待很快与大家分享！

目前还没有正式的 3.3.2 开发版本，因为几个路线图项目仍在进行中。 如果您真的很喜欢冒险并且迫不及待，您可以尝试我们的“夜间”构建。 说明位于“自动开发构建”标题下。

与此同时，我们计划在未来几周内发布 GIMP 3.2.6。 它是一个稳定版本，因此不会包含此处描述的许多新功能。 然而，它将有许多重要的错误修复和小改进。 我们将在 3.2.6 发布新闻文章中详细讨论这些内容！
